headline: Max Ventures files substantial acquisition disclosure under SEBI Takeover Code
sum: Max Ventures Investment Holdings Private Limited filed a Regulation 31(4) disclosure with NSE regarding substantial acquisition of Max India Limited shares. The disclosure triggers mandatory acquirer obligations under the SEBI Takeover Regulations, 2011.
detail: Max Ventures Investment Holdings Private Limited submitted the statutory disclosure to NSE under Regulation 31(4) of SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, confirming material acquisition of Max India Limited. This disclosure is a mandatory filing once an acquirer crosses the 5% threshold (for listed acquirers) or 10% threshold (for non-promoter acquirers), and triggers cascading obligations including open offer, director appointments, and voting disclosures. The timing and nature of disclosure suggest preparation for formal takeover process.
